'''2008 Evergreen Mini-Open''' was a ''Star Wars'' CCG mini-open played on Sunday 17 August 2008 at the Federal Way Regional Library, 34200 1st Way S., Federal Way, Washington, with [[Steve Harpster]] as tournament director.<ref name="sf-21995-316849">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=316849#p316849 Mini-Open Federal Way, WA August 17], itcouldbewirfs (Chris Wirfs), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (21 July 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261125193007/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t21995.html Internet Archive]</ref> [[Ryan French]] received its bye to Day 2 of the [[2008 World Championship]].<ref name="sf-22883-332133">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=332133#p332133 List of People who have Worlds Day Two Auto Bids 2008], simone89, Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (29 August 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261125194535/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t22883.html Internet Archive]</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Site:''' Federal Way Regional Library, 34200 1st Way S., Federal Way, Washington<ref name="sf-21995-316849" />
* '''Dates:''' 17 August 2008<ref name="sf-21995-316849" />
* '''Time:''' 12 pm to about 6 or 6:30 pm<ref name="sf-21995-316849" />
* '''Format:''' constructed, Championship level; with fewer than eight players, four rounds and a final confrontation; with eight or more, six rounds and no final confrontation<ref name="sf-21995-316849" />
* '''Entry fee:''' $10<ref name="sf-21995-316849" />
* '''Tournament director:''' [[Steve Harpster]], using the three-judge system so that he could play<ref name="sf-21995-316849" />

== Organization ==

[[Chris Wirfs]] announced the Evergreen Mini-Open on 21 July 2008. The first $34 of the entry fees went to the Players Committee; the rest was to be paid 50% to first place, with the bye to Day 2 of the World Championship, 30% to second and 20% to third.<ref name="sf-21995-316849" />

== Results ==

No results were posted in the forum topic. The list of 2008 Worlds Day 2 auto bids that Cedric (simone89) posted gives "August 17th Federal Way WA Mini Open Ryan French".<ref name="sf-22883-332133" />
